1. Exemptions allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The applications are accordingly disposed of.

3. The present application under Section 439 read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks interim bail in case FIR No. 62/2020, under Sections 376/506 of the IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act,
registered at P.S. Vijay Vihar.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to verify the Admit Card of the applicant.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
